name: Apple Motion Smoothing
author: zysilm
punchline: Smoother motion with real in-between frames from your Mac's Apple silicon
description:
Doubles the video's frame rate while it plays, with in-between frames made by Apple's frame interpolation (VideoToolbox) on your Mac's Apple silicon: not blended frames. Video ▸ Apple Motion Smoothing… opens a window to choose Off, Double Frame Rate or Match Display (the doubled frames paced to the display, with GPU rendering) and shows what runs or why not. The command palette and Ask Vestra can also choose a mode in one step. Needs a Mac with Apple silicon and macOS 15.4 or newer; it does nothing on other computers or systems. Off by default; remembers your choice.
→ Menu: Video ▸ Apple Motion Smoothing
